## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

Use native units in MetOffice integration.

I'm curious, should this (and other identical PRs for other weather integrations) be considered a breaking change? I imagine some automations and Lovelace cards may disregard units and may behave differently when values suddenly change after this.
